Definition: to shriek; (by implication) to proclaim (an assembly)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cry, cry out, call, cry for help; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cry, cry out (for help); 1a2) to cry, cry out (in distress or need); 1a3) to make outcry, clamour; 1b) (Niphal) to be summoned; 1c) (Piel) to cry aloud (in grief); 1d) (Hiphil) to call together
